head: GROTESK
dzh: 白底黑字红色块、严格网格
den: White, black type, red blocks, strict grid
nzh: 12 栏严格网格，全部左对齐不居中；标题超大粗无衬线、字距收紧；红色大色块只用一两处，用 01 02 03 编号和粗黑线分区；没有圆角、阴影和渐变
nen: Strict 12-column grid, everything left-aligned; huge bold tightly tracked sans headings; one or two big red blocks, numbered sections and heavy black rules; no radius, shadow or gradient
